sv.title: Pekas ut som C-ministrar: Thand kan peta Busch
sv.summary: Centerpartisterna tros säga ja till Ulf Kristersson. Om Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist tar C till Rosenbad kan hon själv peta Ebba Busch. Expressen har kartlagt namnen det snackas om – däribland en oväntad comeback.

en.title: Named as C ministers: Thand could oust Busch
en.summary: Centre Party members are expected to say yes to Ulf Kristersson. If Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist takes C to Rosenbad, she could herself oust Ebba Busch. Expressen has mapped the names being discussed – including an unexpected comeback.
